d:
A sequel to the Chaos Route Ending of Shin Megami Tensei: Strange Journey with a key difference.

The difference being: Ashera, a fan favorite demoness babe, survives the events of the plot and was central to the agent - the game's antihero - having planet Earth engulfed by the demonic dimension known as "Scwhartzwelt".

Also an exploration of Ashera as a character and how she would live within a world reborn of instinct and might make right ruling.
